newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Low offer in India kero tender, MidEast plus $1.39.
newsitem.headline: Low offer in India kero tender, MidEast plus $1.39.

text.p: Offers into state-owned Indian Oil Corp's (IOC) superior kerosene import tender for November arrival was seen at a low premium of $1.39 a barrel to MidEast spot quotes on a cost-and-freight (c-and-f) basis to the west coast, traders said on Friday.
They said the offer was made by a Mediterranean trader.
Low offers were also made to the east coast by a German trader at a $1.49-a-barrel premium to MidEast quotes, c-and-f, with the next best offer at a $1.94-premium.
Traders said the $1.49-premium is a very low price.
High offers to the west coast were seen at $2.83 premium, while east coast offers were seen at $2.38 premium.
A low offer on a Singapore spot quotes basis to the east coast was made by a major at a 95-cent premium, while another German trader offered at a $1.10-premium, c-and-f, traders said.
Traders said they expect India to take three to four cargoes of kerosene in this tender.
In its last tender for October delivery, IOC bought 210,000 tonnes of kerosene in five cargoes.
